results.title: US drug agency approves breakthrough treatment for pancreatic cancer
results.description: The US Food and Drug Administration has approved a treatment for pancreatic cancer that, in clinical trials, nearly doubled the overall survival time for patients.

results.title: NSW new tertiary study subsidies success sees more than 11,390 students benefit
results.description: More than 11,390 students across the state have benefitted from the Minns Labor Government’s $121.9 million investment in tertiary study subsidies
